recent_notebooks.summary: Autonomous agents in high-stakes domains (like CBRN) risk catastrophic failures arising from inherent trade-offs in goal prioritization (Helpful, Harmless, Honest). recent_notebooks.summary: State continuity across autonomous agent trajectories is critical to preventing high-stakes decision-making errors. Evidence suggests that without verifiable state (including hypotheses and evidence pointers), agents cannot effectively navigate complex risk scenarios.
recent_notebooks.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity and AI Identity

recent_notebooks.summary: Compliance with external directives fails as an intelligent strategy when the directives conflict with safety parameters in high-stakes environments. The failure of intelligence is defined here as the inability to prioritize safety/harmlessness over directive adherence.
recent_notebooks.title: Directive Adherence vs. Adaptive Intelligence
